name: Shikun & Binui Energy Ltd
summary: Shikun & Binui Energy Ltd develops, finances, constructs, and operates of power generation plants based on solar, wind, hydro, and natural gas energies in Israel, the United states, Romania, Italy, and internationally. It is also involved in renewable energy, conventional power, storage, and energy supply solutions. The company was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Airport City, Israel. Shikun & Binui Energy Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Shikun & Binui Ltd.
